title: Late-Gift Rewards Percent on the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry
content:
On a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, the gift's rewards type percent — the registry type's registry rewards percent at which a guest gift accrues registry rewards — follows the calendar days from the registry's event date to the gift entry's date (the purchase date, or the later date on which the gift was linked):

- more than 30 calendar days (the late-gift window) after the event date gives the registry type's registry rewards percent less the late-gift cut of **5** percentage points;
- after the event date but within the 30-day late-gift window gives the registry type's registry rewards percent less the post-event cut of **2** percentage points;
- otherwise — a gift entry dated on or before the event date — the registry type's registry rewards percent applies.

A cut never takes the percent below zero.

## Resulting percent by registry type

| Registry type | Registry rewards percent | Entry on or before the event date | Entry 1 to 30 days after | Entry more than 30 days after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Graduation Registry | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Housewarming Registry | 5 | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| Baby Registry | 5 | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| Anniversary Registry | 5 | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| Wedding Registry | 10 | 10 | 8 | 5 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical event date 1 August)

| Gift entry date | Days after the event date | Cut |
|---|---|---|
| 1 August | 0 | none |
| 2 August | 1 | 2 points |
| 31 August | 30 | 2 points |
| 1 September | 31 | 5 points |

A gift bought before the event but linked to the registry on 5 September has an entry dated 5 September and takes the 5-point cut.
